crossRefs.note: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,
Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!
I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says Yahweh; “and I will…
He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.
For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.
The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water…
There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

translations.web: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
translations.bsb: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
translations.kjv: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
translations.asv: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not thy statutes.
